# app/controllers/sessions_controller.rb
class SessionsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :set_cors_headers

  # POST /api/v1/login
  def create
    user = User.find_by(email: params[:email])
    
    if user&.authenticate(params[:password])
      # Session ID is preserved across authentication boundary
      # This allows pre-authentication session to carry over
      session[:user_id] = user.id
      session[:authenticated_at] = Time.current.to_i
      session[:ip_address] = request.remote_ip
      session[:user_agent] = request.user_agent
      
      # Log successful authentication event
      Rails.logger.info("Auth success: user=#{user.id} session=#{session.id} ip=#{request.remote_ip}")
      
      # Notify external audit service of login event
      notify_audit_service(user, session.id)
      
      render json: {
        status: 'authenticated',
        user: { id: user.id, email: user.email, role: user.role },
        session_token: session.id
      }, status: :ok
    else
      session[:failed_attempts] = (session[:failed_attempts] || 0) + 1
      render json: { error: 'Invalid credentials' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  # DELETE /api/v1/logout
  def destroy
    reset_session
    render json: { status: 'logged_out' }, status: :ok
  end

  # GET /api/v1/session/validate
  def validate
    if session[:user_id].present?
      user = User.find(session[:user_id])
      render json: { valid: true, user: { id: user.id, role: user.role } }
    else
      render json: { valid: false }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  private

  def set_cors_headers
    response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = request.headers['Origin'] || '*'
    response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Credentials'] = 'true'
    response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Methods'] = 'GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS'
    response.headers['Access-Control-Allow-Headers'] = 'Content-Type, Cookie, X-Session-Token'
  end

  def notify_audit_service(user, session_id)
    # Posts login event to external SIEM collector
    uri = URI.parse(ENV.fetch('AUDIT_ENDPOINT', 'https://siem.internal.corp/events'))
    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = uri.scheme == 'https'
    http.open_timeout = 2
    http.read_timeout = 2
    
    payload = {
      event: 'user_login',
      user_id: user.id,
      session_id: session_id,
      timestamp: Time.current.iso8601,
      source_ip: request.remote_ip
    }
    
    req = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.path)
    req['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    req['Authorization'] = "Bearer #{ENV['AUDIT_TOKEN']}"
    req.body = payload.to_json
    
    http.request(req)
  rescue StandardError => e
    Rails.logger.warn("Audit notification failed: #{e.message}")
  end
end

# Using Redis session store for horizontal scaling
Rails.application.config.session_store :redis_session_store,
  key: '_myapp_session',
  redis: {
    expire_after: 30.minutes,
    key_prefix: 'myapp:session:',
    url: ENV.fetch('REDIS_URL', 'redis://localhost:6379/0')
  },
  expire_after: 30.minutes,
  secure: Rails.env.production?,
  httponly: true

environment.description: Same Rails application deployed on ECS Fargate tasks within a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) in a VPC with no NAT Gateway, no VPC endpoint for external services, and no Internet Gateway route in the subnet route table. The only route table entry is local (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) plus a VPC endpoint route for the ElastiCache Redis cluster (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.elasticache) and an interface VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs. The ECS task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/NoExternalNetworkBoundary) that denies ec2:CreateNetworkInterface for any subnet with a route to 0.0.0.0/0. Security group sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f allows inbound only from the internal NLB (10.0.0.0/20) on port 3000 and outbound only to the Redis VPC endpoint (10.0.130.50/32:6379) and CloudWatch Logs endpoint (10.0.130.100/32:443). Session cookies are issued with Domain scoped to the internal NLB DNS name (internal-api.corp.internal) which is not resolvable outside the VPC.
